تنتجعن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَجِعْنَ (tantajiʕna) /tan.ta.d͡ʒiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# تُنْتَجَعْنَ (tuntajaʕna) /tun.ta.d͡ʒaʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
